bullets.text: In Gummidipoondi, a contract worker died and two others fell critical due to toxic gas exposure during chemical transfer at a plant, requiring safety inspections.
Heavy rains caused severe waterlogging and flooding across residential areas and schools in Thiruverkadu, Ambattur, and Poonamallee, prompting emergency drainage measures.
Chennai Police arrested a man on Sardar Patel Road for robbing twenty-four lakh rupees from a pharmaceutical employee, highlighting the need for increased patrols.
Vanathi Srinivasan and environmental groups criticized plans to reduce the Pallikaranai wetland boundaries, prompting the office to monitor buffer zone preservation.
Velachery and Chennai roads continue to face severe risks from motorists driving on the wrong side, requiring stricter traffic enforcement by authorities.
Workers at the North Chennai Thermal Power Station in Ponneri staged a demonstration demanding the withdrawal of the smart meter scheme, requiring labor dialogue.
The National Green Tribunal directed the Avadi Corporation to stop solid waste pollution in the Cooum River, which the district team must oversee.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay and Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong inaugurated CapitaLand's forty-six megawatt data centre in Ambattur SIDCO Industrial Estate.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay launched the Tamil Nadu Semiconductor Ecosystem Scheme to position the state as a premier electronics manufacturing hub.
Greater Chennai Corporation Mayor R. Priya criticized the TVK government for cancelling seven hundred crore rupees worth of tenders, requiring political tracking.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay launched a three thousand one hundred eight crore rupee ring main pipeline project to interlink water sources for equitable supply.
